subject: Brightwell pilot — mutual action roadmap & evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@brightwell.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Brightwell pilot — mutual action roadmap & evaluation timeline

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking time last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a concise mutual action roadmap to align goals, owners, and a proposed timeline for the Brightwell pilot. I’ve put a short draft MAP and the initial eval prompt set in the attachments so we have something concrete to iterate on.

High-level goals (please confirm):
- Validate extractive classification model at >= 90% F1 on the 3 pilot datasets
- Average inference latency < 200ms p95 for 512-token requests
- Cost target: < $0.35 per 1k tokens during the pilot

Proposed timeline (6 weeks):
1) Week 0 (this week): kickoff, access & data handoff
2) Weeks 1–2: ingest sample data, baseline model selection & quick eval
3) Weeks 3–4: tuning/quantization experiments, stability tests
4) Week 5: final eval & quality signoff with champion
5) Week 6: handoff and next-steps (scale or extend)

Ask: can you confirm the goals and that you’ll be the champion for signoff? Also — who else on your side should be in the loop for data and infra (I’d expect a product lead and an engineer). If that looks good, I propose a 30-minute kickoff next Thursday (24 Jun) at 10:00 AM PT.

Attachments: [Attachment: Brightwell_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)], [Attachment: Brightwell_eval_prompts.md (md, 6KB)]

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Soojin —

Thanks for the clear plan and the drafts. I’ll act as the champion for the pilot and confirm the goals above look correct from Brightwell’s side. I’m looping in Priya (Product Lead) and Marco (Senior Engineer) — they’ll help with data prep and our infra constraints.

Two asks up front:
- Can you share SOC 2 / security posture docs and an outline of data retention controls?
- We need a simple CSV schema template for the sample data (column names + typing) so our engineers can export quickly.

The proposed kickoff on Thu 24 Jun 10:00 AM PT works for us.
